capabilities: Render Nextcloud task lists in a note via a code block
Create, edit, complete and delete tasks directly on the server
Filter tasks by list, due date, preview count and completion status
Connect with an app password and configure, reorder and colour task lists
disambiguation: Not a local task manager; it only shows and edits tasks stored on a Nextcloud server and writes nothing to the vault.
extras: Only fields the plugin shows are written back, so server-side repeat rules, reminders, descriptions and subtasks are preserved; moving a task between lists must be done in Nextcloud itself; English and German interfaces.
motivation: The author wanted exactly one copy of every task, living in Nextcloud, after seeing other CalDAV plugins mirror markdown checkboxes into notes where the two copies risk drifting apart.
problem: Other CalDAV plugins mirror tasks as markdown checkboxes in notes, creating a second copy that can drift out of sync with the server.

relations.evidence: Read, create, edit and complete your Nextcloud Tasks right inside a note — over CalDAV

summary: CalDAV client that displays and manages tasks stored on a Nextcloud server inside notes, without writing any task data to the vault.
